features.name: Unarmored Defense
features.description: While you are wearing no armor and not wielding a shield, your AC equals 10 + your Dexterity modifier + your Wisdom modifier. (Baked into armor_class.)

features.name: Martial Arts
features.description: While unarmed or wielding only monk weapons (shortswords and simple melee weapons without two-handed or heavy) and no armor or shield: you can use Dexterity instead of Strength for unarmed strikes and monk weapons; you can roll a d4 in place of the normal damage of your unarmed strike or monk weapon; and when you use the Attack action with an unarmed strike or a monk weapon, you can make one unarmed strike as a bonus action. (Dexterity and the martial arts die are baked into the unarmed_strike / shortsword actions; the bonus-action strike is the sim's martial_arts convention.)

features.name: Ki
features.description: You have 2 ki points, regained on a short or long rest (resources[] ki). Some ki features require your target to make a saving throw: Ki save DC = 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Wisdom modifier (12).

features.name: Flurry of Blows
features.description: Immediately after you take the Attack action on your turn, you can spend 1 ki point to make two unarmed strikes as a bonus action. (The sim's flurry_of_blows convention, paid from the ki pool.)

features.name: Patient Defense
features.description: You can spend 1 ki point to take the Dodge action as a bonus action on your turn. (Modelled: bonus_action_grant dodge, usage 1 ki.)

features.name: Step of the Wind
features.description: You can spend 1 ki point to take the Disengage or Dash action as a bonus action on your turn, and your jump distance is doubled for the turn. (Modelled: bonus_action_grant dash / disengage, usage 1 ki; the doubled jump distance is not modelled.)

features.name: Unarmored Movement
features.description: Your speed increases by 10 feet while you are not wearing armor or wielding a shield. (Baked into speed.walk 40.)
